title: Reclaim Procedure
text:
| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Owner | Cloud FinOps |
| Status | REVIEW |
| Last reviewed | 2026-08-16 |
| Audience | Internal |

1. Notify the owner (7-day grace)
2. Snapshot the VM
3. Stop the VM
4. Wait 14 days
5. Delete if unclaimed

```
# example (Azure CLI)
az vm deallocate -g rg-name -n vm-name
az vm delete -g rg-name -n vm-name --yes
```
